adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb `perform_retrieve` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, before falling back to `fetch_http`. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` does a blocking `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates/imports items. This is indeed running a full feed fetch/import inline within the embed retrieval path (which is invoked from `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`), creating a performance/architecture concern (tying up a worker and potentially re-polling the entire feed per embed retrieval), though it’s not a directly verifiable correctness/security defect from the diff alone.
